module_summary: Sequence-checking Moore FSM: after s starts it, eight states count w=1 occurrences over each 3-cycle window and assert z when exactly two.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Encodes idle, window position and count of w=1 seen in the current 3-cycle window.

anchors.name: w
anchors.why: Sampled input whose ones are counted by the FSM each window.

anchors.name: s
anchors.why: Start condition: moves FSM out of reset state A.

anchors.name: z
anchors.why: Moore output decoded from state C: window had exactly two ones.

groups.name: window_fsm
groups.description: State register with next-state logic counting w over 3-cycle windows.
